summary_en: 4,000,000 shares (1.28% of outstanding) up to ¥1,000M. Open-market purchase via broker, 17 July–30 September 2026. Reason: shareholder returns and capital-efficiency improvements.
title_en: Notification regarding determination of matters relating to acquisition of treasury shares (acquisition of treasury shares based on the articles of incorporation per Article 165(2) of the Companies Act)
translation_en_brief: Nippon Parking Development announced on 5 June 2026 that its board of directors resolved to acquire treasury shares under Article 156(1) of the Companies Act (as applied via Article 165(3)). The company will repurchase up to 4,000,000 ordinary shares, representing 1.28% of issued shares excluding treasury stock, for an aggregate amount not exceeding ¥1,000,000,000. Purchases will be executed through open-market transactions via a broker on the Tokyo Stock Exchange, with execution scheduled between 17 July and 30 September 2026. The stated rationale is to enhance shareholder returns and capital efficiency while enabling flexible capital policy adjustments in response to changes in the operating environment.
